en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal Bin Maymoun, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> molar was loosened by the woad (a dyeing plant)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from ibn Faddal from Tha’labah ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “
Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘Woad has affected my molar teeth. 5 ”
